critical_code_review_comments: Observation (not a bug): After the Trustindex loader runs it removes/replaces its own <script src='.../loader.js...'> tag, so document.querySelectorAll("script[src*='trustindex.io/loader.js']").length is 0 after render. The useEffect guard in ReviewsSection.tsx uses document.querySelector(`script[src="${TRUSTINDEX_SRC}"]`) to prevent duplicate injection. Since the script tag disappears, a React re-render could potentially re-inject the loader. Not reproduced in practice (React 18 StrictMode did not duplicate the widget), but consider using a module-level boolean flag (hasInjectedTrustindex) in addition to the DOM check for robustness.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 leads via UI: 'Review Tester' from reviews-quote-btn modal (id f6e20dcc-8bff-4a41-b672-e0a51b359866, package 'Custom Bali Trip') and 'Hero Regression Tester' from hero form (id 0d5fedc1-d1dc-494c-990b-f3365d148c4d, package 'Custom Bali Trip').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trustindex is third-party and lazy-loads on real user activity (mouse.move + mouse.wheel). Use page.goto(url, wait_until='load') — networkidle will timeout because Trustindex keeps connections open. After scrollIntoView + a few mouse.wheel ticks + wait ~5s, '.ti-widget' and '.ti-review-item' nodes appear. The loader <script> tag self-removes after execution, so count==0 is expected and not a bug. Reviews-section CTA testid: reviews-quote-btn opens EnquiryDialog (title 'Get Your Custom Bali Quote', package 'Custom Bali Trip').
